nodes.name: full-text-search.md
nodes.summary: Reference for BM25-ranked full-text search on Neon Postgres using the lakebase_text extension and lakebase_bm25 index over tsvector columns, covering indexing, querying and interpreting scores, candidate limits, prefiltering, and parameter tuning.

nodes.name: hybrid-search.md
nodes.summary: Reference for combining Lakebase Search's vector (lakebase_vector) and BM25 (lakebase_text) retrieval into hybrid search via a reciprocal rank fusion example, since Lakebase Search has no built-in hybrid function.

nodes.name: vector-search.md
nodes.summary: Reference for approximate nearest-neighbor semantic search on Neon Postgres with the lakebase_vector extension (pgvector-compatible), covering extension setup, embedding columns, building and tuning the lakebase_ann index, querying, and selective prefiltering.
